```bash

```

> `omac work show` 和 `omac work submit` 都可能长时间运行。任何工具调用在拿到最终 tool_result 和终态退出码前都不完整。若工具返回 running/session、缺少最终 tool_result、出现空输出或不完整输出，必须等待或轮询到终态。使用足够长的 wait/yield，或保留并恢复续接句柄；这是通用终态规则，不绑定某个具体工具 API。timeout/yield 不是空结果，也不允许据此停止。`omac work show` 只有在退出码 0 且得到可解析 JSON 后才能继续。`omac work submit` 只有在最终 tool_result 明确给出退出码 0，且 JSON 包含 `"ok": true`、`"terminal": true` 和 `"next_action": "stop"` 时才可宣称成功。结果未知时不得宣称成功或结束；validation error 必须修复后重新提交。submit 成功就是本次执行的最后动作，立即停止，不再执行任何平台写入。

> 在上方精确的 `omac work show` 命令以退出码 0 成功返回可解析 JSON 前，不得执行任何其他 Issue 查询（包括 `multica issue get`、`multica issue comment list` 或 metadata 查询），也不得开始分析任务内容。work show 成功后，只能在返回上下文确有需要时使用只读 Issue 查询。禁止任何会创建、修改或删除 Issue 状态的 `multica issue` 写操作。这是语义边界，不是穷举命令清单；禁止示例包括 `multica issue status`、`multica issue assign`、`multica issue comment`、`multica issue metadata`、`multica issue rerun`、`multica issue cancel-task`、`multica issue update`、`multica issue create`、`multica issue label`、`multica issue property`、`multica issue reorder` 和 `multica issue subscriber`。只允许使用上方给出的精确 `omac work show` 命令，以及 work show 返回的精确 `omac work submit` 命令作为 OMAC 控制命令；已有手工附件或 verification 但缺少 `delivery_identity` 时也必须通过该 submit 命令封存。

review_obligations.requirement: Ownership, boundaries, and unique write paths
Prior blocker regression and changed-scope review

blocker_facts.summary: Internal exceptions can escape Authorize instead of producing the required Deny decision.
blocker_facts.evidence: internal/authorization/engine.go:211-224 invokes CurrentPolicy and evaluateWithPolicy directly; :258-275 and :311-318 call subject/access resolvers directly. There is no recover/exception-to-decision boundary anywhere in internal/authorization. Returned dependency errors are handled, but internal exceptions are not. docs/design/detailed/09-governance-and-security-detailed-design.md:287, docs/references/governance/security-and-enterprise.md:259 and docs/delivery/acceptance-and-validation.md:201 explicitly require internal errors/exceptions to return Deny. Static source finding; existing declared tests exercised returned-error paths, not an exception path.
blocker_facts.required_fix: Add an explicit fail-closed exception boundary for authorization evaluation that preserves safe provenance and yields a stable internal-error Deny reason without exposing raw panic content. Cover unexpected policy/access/subject evaluation exceptions in the declared suite and ensure protected policy-management evaluation paths follow the same failure semantics.

blocker_facts.summary: Authentication-strength requirements do not consume the verified AuthenticationContext.
blocker_facts.evidence: internal/authorization/engine.go:342-363 handles only principal_kind and different_principal_id specially; every other qualification compares against request.Attributes. No production code in this package reads RequestContext.Authentication.AuthenticationStrength. contracts/identity/requestcontext/request_context.go:21-29 defines that verified fact; docs/references/governance/security-and-enterprise.md:29 and :245 require it to support authorization tightening. Existing requirement tests at internal/authorization/engine_test.go:210-245 cover principal kind, independence, environment and source, but not authentication strength. Static source finding; no additional security experiment was constructed.
blocker_facts.required_fix: Define the supported authentication-strength requirement and evaluate it from RequestContext.Authentication.AuthenticationStrength with explicit supported semantics; do not let generic attributes shadow canonical authenticated identity facts. Add positive, insufficient-strength, missing-fact and conflicting-attribute regression coverage to the declared authorization suite.
